# EFM3D Scene Embeddings {#efm3d-scene-embeddings}

This page retains cited background on EFM3D/EVL and Project Aria assets
[@EFM3D-straub2024]. It is not a schema or implementation owner. The thesis
defines the actor-visible information boundary; Python docstrings, config, and
tests define readers, caches, and validation. Planned representations must not
be inferred from this navigation page.

See [EFM3D/EVL literature](../literature/efm3d.qmd), [ASE dataset](../ase_dataset.qmd),
and [semi-dense point clouds](semi-dense-pc.qmd). The canonical project
discussion is in the [Typst thesis](../../typst/thesis/main.typ).
